segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A crowd had followed Jesus after He fed thousands with a few loaves. They wanted more bread. He gave them something deeper.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Not the kind you chew. The kind that satisfies the part of you food can't reach.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I am that bread of life.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The bread their ancestors ate in the wilderness didn't keep them alive forever. But the bread Jesus gives does.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He was speaking of Himself — given, like bread broken, so the world could have life.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Come hungry. He is the bread that actually fills you.
